asset_price.decomposition: USD price 1.11937 = EUR/USD 1.12015 (FX) x token/EUR 0.99930 (peg): FX moves and token depeg are separate risks

reconciliation.rule: coverage = (idle + supply resolved in Morpho markets) / totalAssets; any shortfall is kept as an 'unattributed' exposure with a conservative failure model (never zero risk)

rates.source: DefiLlama hacks: 25 incidents >= $1,000,000 in last 3y on the 613 protocols with TVL >= $10,000,000 (upper bound: 266 incidents / 1284 protocols with TVL >= $1,000,000 = 6.91%/y)

sim_partial.method: eth_call redeem() with a state override on the share balance of 0xdEaD (read-only, no tx)

force_plan.rule: cover (amount - ordinary capacity) x (1 + 0.1%); cheapest penalty first, then deepest free liquidity; <= 99.9% of each market's free liquidity

sim_force.method: eth_call VaultV2.multicall([forceDeallocate(...)..., redeem(...)]) with a state override on the share balance of 0xdEaD (read-only, no tx)
